question: Which platform is right for my website?
answer: It depends on your goals. Shopify suits brands that want a powerful, easy-to-manage online store. WordPress suits businesses that publish and update content often. A custom-built website or landing page suits projects that need a unique design, specific features or maximum performance. We recommend the right option during discovery.

question: What should I prepare before our first meeting?
answer: A short description of your business and goals, a few websites you like, and any brand assets you already have, such as a logo or colors. If you are not sure about content or structure yet, that is fine: shaping it is part of our discovery process.

question: Can I update the website myself after launch?
answer: Yes, when your project needs it. Our WordPress websites include full content management, Shopify stores come with the Shopify admin for running your store, and our e-commerce websites include an admin dashboard. We choose the setup that fits how your team prefers to work day to day.

question: Do you work with clients outside Egypt?
answer: Yes. Most of our work is remote, with clients across North America and the Gulf as well as Egypt. Meetings are scheduled in Cairo time and shown in your local time when you book.
